result.stdout:
BidiLint — lint localization files for bidi (bidirectional text) pitfalls.

Usage: bidilint <path> [<path>...] [--base <culture>] [--format text|json] [--strict]

  <path>      Folder or file to lint. May be repeated.
  --base      Base culture other cultures are compared against (default: en).
  --format    text (default) or json.
  --strict    Treat warnings as failures too. Errors always fail.
  --help      Show this help.
  --version   Show the version.

Formats: JSON, .resx, Android res/values XML, Apple .strings, gettext PO/POT, Flutter ARB.
Exit codes: 0 clean · 1 usage · 2 input/path · 3 no locale files or base missing ·
            4 findings · 5 internal error.
